أتلاحم (form VI)
# أَتَلَاحَمُ (ʔatalāḥamu) /ʔa.ta.laː.ħa.mu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَلَاحَمَ (talāḥama)
# أَتَلَاحَمَ (ʔatalāḥama) /ʔa.ta.laː.ħa.ma/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَلَاحَمَ (talāḥama)
# أَتَلَاحَمْ (ʔatalāḥam) /ʔa.ta.laː.ħam/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَلَاحَمَ (talāḥama)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
